import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = [int(v) for v in data[1:1 + n]]
    res = []
    for i in range(n):
        last = -1
        for j in range(i):
            if a[j] > a[i]:
                last = j
        res.append(i - last)
    print(" ".join(str(v) for v in res))


main()

import random

rng = random.Random(20260926)
N = 100000
vals = []
b = 0
while len(vals) < N:
    length = min(rng.randint(5000, 15000), N - len(vals))
    base = 9000000 - b * 200000
    v = base + rng.randint(0, 1000)
    for _ in range(length):
        v = max(base, v + rng.randint(-3, 10))
        vals.append(v)
    b += 1
print(N)
